0083.verdict: METASTABLE IN DFT; DISORDERED SOLID SOLUTION POSSIBLE AT HIGH T
0083.verdict_note: T*dS_conf(1000 K) = 19.9 meV/atom exceeds the +14.2 hull depth, so a disordered Al/Cu solid solution could be favoured at 1000 K. Not a 0 K ground state.

1157.verdict: VERIFIED DFT GROUND STATE (scoped to tested set)
1157.verdict_note: At or below the hull within 3-5 meV/atom pipeline noise.

1586.verdict_note: Full-system LP depth +9.9 (binding c_Mn2B x0.50, c_ZrB2 x2.50, Zr ref x0.50); the interim -14.2 was the stated-reaction tie-line only and missed the lower Mn2B tie-line. No magnetic special is lower than the FM relax (best +0.1 meV/atom); the specials do not re-verify it.

2575.verdict_note: V6C5 parked (never converged); a formation energy below ~ -0.58 eV/atom would flip it. Not a verification.

3379.verdict_note: No non-negative decomposition from the 4 listed competitors alone (Nb3B4, Mo2B5, NbB2, MoB2); LP infeasible as specified. Full-system LP incl. elemental refs IS feasible: -124.5 meV/atom (binding c_MoB2 x1.00, c_NbB2 x3.00, Mo ref x2.00), i.e. below the full hull — the difference is entirely the elemental refs, which the specified test excludes. T*dS_conf(1000 K) upper bound 18.4 meV/atom (full Nb/Mo disorder) does not change the specified-test outcome.

2802.verdict_note: Al3Ni parked (never converged); missing competitor can only push the depth higher. Marginal vs 3-5 meV noise.

1743.verdict_note: +3.3 meV/atom above the QE hull — marginal: only 0.3 meV/atom above the +3 verification line and inside the 3-5 meV/atom pipeline noise. The Lu2Ni3B6 tie-line flipped it from the provisional -181.2; treat as on-the-hull within noise rather than a firm rejection.

3171.verdict: VERIFIED DFT GROUND STATE (scoped to tested set)
3171.verdict_note: At or below the hull within 3-5 meV/atom pipeline noise.

0982.verdict_note: Clean re-run converged in the higher electronic basin (+115.2). A lower electronic state is known (evidence attempt0 reached -972.87710 Ry, unrelaxed) bounding the true depth at <= +35.8. Metastable on all evidence.

t3379_Nb3Mo3B8.assumption: full Nb/Mo disorder on the 6-site metal sublattice (3 Nb + 3 Mo); B sublattice ordered

t0083_Ti2Al3Cu.assumption: full Al/Cu disorder on the 4-site Al/Cu sublattice (3 Al + 1 Cu); Ti sublattice ordered
